title: Esquiva 3D — hardening follow-ups from TASK-019 review (LOW)
description: Non-gating LOW findings from the independent review of TASK-019 (Esquiva 3D). Captured for later; the demo is shipped and works. Address opportunistically.
acceptance_criteria: DodgeGameBootstrap guards against fallSpeed <= 0 (clamp in Start or race the death-fall WaitUntil with a max-time WaitForSeconds) so a bad Inspector value cannot hang the restart coroutine
Add a DodgeSim test asserting diagonal-input normalization: inputX=1,inputZ=1 over 1s advances exactly playerSpeed along the diagonal (not playerSpeed*sqrt(2))

Optional NIT cleanup: fix stale 'grace=0' comment (DodgeSimTests.cs:81), add epsilon note to the float-boundary catch test (DodgeSimTests.cs:138), and consider snapping a dying obstacle's fall to its last grid cell XZ

From TASK-021/022 review (rev-dodge, LOW-1): DodgeGameBootstrap._obstacleBaselineY is a single shared field set to modelGroundY when ANY enemy prefab loads — under a partial/mixed model load, primitive-fallback obstacles inherit modelGroundY (0) instead of 0.35f and sit half-buried. Resolve baseline per-obstacle. Latent edge only (all-or-nothing load is the real case)

From TASK-022 review (NIT-1): strengthen Jump_RecoverBackInside_LandOnSolidSurvives — a single Tick(0.6,1,1) does takeoff+landing in one frame so it passes even without jump immunity; step it with smaller dt so the genuine fly-over-void immunity is exercised by this test, not only Jump_AirborneFallImmunity

From TASK-022 review (NIT-2): add a DodgeSim test that RequestJump() while State==Lost/Won is a no-op; optionally expose jumpDuration as a serialized Bootstrap field so designers can tune airtime from the Inspector (currently only jumpApex is)
Fast dotnet suite stays green after changes

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
REACHABLE HALF DONE + REVIEWED → WAITING-ON-GATE (not closed; loop mode). The DodgeSim fast-suite ACs are complete, green, and independently reviewed; the DodgeGameBootstrap MonoBehaviour ACs ride the Unity gate.

DONE (fast-suite, commit 936179e — test-only, DodgeSim.cs UNCHANGED): AC2 diagonal-normalization LOCK (Tick_DiagonalInput_NormalisedToPlayerSpeed, mutation-verified non-vacuous — removing the mag>1 normalization gives 7.07 vs 5); AC5 strengthened jump fly-over-void immunity (Jump_RecoverBackInside_LandOnSolidSurvives now multi-substep, frame-1 asserts airborne-over-void+Playing, mutation-verified — removing the immunity guard flips Lost vs Playing); AC6-test no-op-jump-in-terminal-state (RequestJump_WhenLost/WhenWon_IsNoOp — honestly disclosed by dev + reviewer as a WEAK contract lock, not a bug-catcher, since Tick short-circuits before consuming a pending jump in a terminal state; accepted as a regression guard against a future consume-before-terminal-check refactor); AC3 comment fixes (stale grace=0 → graceDelay; epsilon note on the AtContactRadius boundary test — the ticket's 'line 138' pointer was blank so the AtContactRadius float-boundary test was annotated instead). Orchestrator independently verified fast suite = 595 green (592+3), zero regression. rev-t020 APPROVE-WITH-NITS (1 LOW, the disclosed AC6 weak-lock).

REMAINING → UNITY GATE (DodgeGameBootstrap MonoBehaviour, needs Editor compile + PlayMode/Inspector — this ticket stays OPEN for them): AC1 guard fallSpeed<=0 (clamp in Start / race the death-fall WaitUntil with a max-time WaitForSeconds); AC4 resolve _obstacleBaselineY per-obstacle (partial/mixed-model-load primitive-fallback obstacles inherit modelGroundY 0 and sit half-buried); AC6-field expose jumpDuration as a serialized Bootstrap field; AC3 obstacle-snap sub-item (snap a dying obstacle's fall to its last grid-cell XZ — determined to be PRESENTATION at DodgeGameBootstrap.cs:528-538, not DodgeSim). Do these in a Unity-gate window alongside the TASK-061 asset cleanup + TASK-027/028/047 gate work.
